# Security policy

This repository holds the source of the Waghorn Technology Ltd website at
waghorn.tech. It is a static site: no accounts, no forms, no database, and no
server-side processing.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please email enquiries@waghorn.tech with the details and, where possible, the
steps to reproduce. Do not open a public issue for a security report.

We will acknowledge your report and let you know what we intend to do about it.

## Scope

In scope: this repository, and the site served at waghorn.tech.

Out of scope: findings that require physical access to a device, social
engineering, denial of service, and reports generated by automated scanners
without a demonstrated impact.
